sentences.text: For a floating-rate loan to an individual for a purpose other than business that is sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges. [E6]
Because that rule prohibits a pre-payment charge in this case, the assumed 4% foreclosure charge is not supported by the applicable directions. [E6, E3]

missing.searched: Checked the applicable 2026 UCB directions for floating-rate loans to individuals for non-business purposes; the rule found says no pre-payment charges may be levied, so there is no permitted charge amount to calculate.
